summary: Tested new Admin Support Inbox feature (backend + frontend). All 18 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_support_inbox.py pass covering auth gate, listing/filters/search/pagination, resolve+idempotency, reopen, reply (mark_resolved true/false, 422 short msg, 404 unknown), and delete. Existing test_support_contact.py regression (6 tests) still green. Frontend smoke on preview URL confirmed: admin sees admin-support-inbox at bottom of Account view; non-admin does not; tabs (open/resolved/all) render with correct counts; row expand/collapse works; reply textarea disables send when <5 chars and enables when >=5; sending with mark_resolved unchecked leaves ticket Open and shows 'Reply sent' confirmation; resolve button flips ticket to Resolved and it moves to Resolved tab; delete button removes row (window.confirm auto-accepted); refresh works; search (button + Enter key) filters; empty-state message renders correctly. Reopen endpoint verified via pytest (UI reopen button rendered only in the resolved-tab detail panel — behavior matches spec).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Admin Support Inbox routes look clean: re.escape used for injection safety, legacy status normalisation via _support_public, proper 401/403/404 status codes, Pydantic Field(min_length=5, max_length=6000) for reply validation.

AdminSupportInbox.jsx: expandedId persists across tab switches which can be confusing UX — after resolving a ticket then switching to Resolved tab, the ticket is silently already 'expanded' so clicking the toggle collapses it (hides Reopen button). Minor UX polish: reset expandedId when switchTab() is called.
AccountDashboard.jsx gates AdminSupportInbox strictly on sub.is_admin — confirmed working for both admin and freshly registered non-admin users.
Support message rate limits (3/user/10min AND 5/IP/10min) — noted for future testers seeding via /api/support/contact; bypass by direct Mongo insert if needed for bulk seeding.
seed_data_creation: Test tickets seeded directly into support_messages via pymongo (marker=TEST_seed_<hex>) to bypass /api/support/contact rate limits. Also created several TEST_* non-admin users during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_admin_support_inbox.py exercises all admin support endpoints with direct Mongo seeding — safe to re-run any time (no rate-limit hits). Pytest uses xdist with loadscope — module-scoped fixtures create a fresh non-admin user per worker so tests are IP-limit-safe. Frontend testing note: Wellness Assistant sheet (data-testid=ai-agent-sheet) auto-opens ~1.2s after Dashboard mount and intercepts clicks — always dismiss via ai-agent-sheet button[aria-label='Close'] before interacting with account-button. Non-admin users must not see admin-support-inbox (confirmed).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 18 backend tests pass and all frontend flows work end-to-end.
